statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-111181 is a high-severity uncaught-exception issue in body-parser fixed in 1.20.9 and 2.4.0. This image still resolves body-parser 1.20.6 (express 4.x) and 2.3.0 (pinned via pnpm overrides for the v2 line). Upstream Trigger.dev enforces pnpm minimumReleaseAge, so those patched releases are not installable in the webapp build yet without relaxing that gate; tracking the override bump once the fixed versions satisfy minimumReleaseAge.
